title: A Trump Loyalist, a Turkish Investor and a Battle for Wealth and Influence
summary: A Turkish businessman once allied with the Maduro regime has tied the knot with President Trump’s former personal lawyer, Alina Habba, at the same time he is seeking to retain a big contract in Venezuela.
